title: John T FDE 21868 NDE 21868
content: Walter and I were putting two disruptive patrons out the door of the bar, when the manager and owner got involved. The manager swung at the big guy and a smaller man started shouting, ‘I'll kill ya!’ He was reaching over Walter and I when he pushed Walter out the door and the other two went out with Walter. I grabbed hold of the door. I heard Walter yell, ‘He's got a gun!’ Walter was wrestling with the little guy and I looked to the right of the door and saw the big guy ejecting a shell into the chamber of a gun. He was pointing the gun in Walter’s direction. I swung at the gun when they both started firing at each other. I was caught in the cross fire. There were thirteen shots fired. I was hit three times, through my right hand, through the left forearm, and in the left arm part of bicep muscle. I saw one bullet pass my eyes and hit concrete right in front of me. During this episode, my spirit left my body. I was looking back at my body shaking uncontrollably. I became very calm but had thoughts of how I was going to explain to Walter’s wife and nine children I tried my best. I thought he was dead. Also how to tell my parents? In the calm was a white light of calmness. Thank you for letting me tell my story, as for today I do not fear death. Two weeks ago, I crashed my motorcycle on our gravel road at approximately forty five miles per hour. I assumed I was knocked out. I picked the bike up, road it home, washed up a little bit, and went to a benefit and Alcoholic’s Anonymous meeting. There were two nurses at the meeting who cleaned me up. They had never been to that meeting before. Then I drove to the benefit all the while people telling me I should go to the hospital. I said, I will be alright. I did not realize I was having blackouts at the time. They called the Sheriff to take me to hospital at the benefit and I wouldn't go. No insurance. Sincerely, John T ‘God works in mysterious ways.’

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Criminal attack shooting, I was wounded 3 times Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was just my spirit.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was not under the influence of alcohol or drugs. I was totally aware.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Extreme calmness.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I believe our spirit leaves our body when it's time.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I feel fortunate to have it happen to me. My belief in honesty is verified.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Some are skeptics. Others have had similar experiences.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: You seemed to ask the right questions. Thank you!
